nextChangePackage.subject: kernel-consumer-sync
nextChangePackage.reason: the Kernel consumer stamp is stale against the appended EPOCH-04 head and must be resynchronised in its own change package, written by its own authorised writer under Codex; this contract only records that GRP-01 is not GREEN and never performs the sync

invariants: GO-RUNTIME-PILOT is never GO-PRODUCTION: promoting this contract at 10/10 GREEN authorises one bounded runtime pilot and opens no release, deploy or production path, and no evaluation may return GO-PRODUCTION.

The gate set is frozen at exactly GRP-01..GRP-10 in this order with these definitions, bound by gateSetSha256 over the ordered [order, id, definition] triples; a renamed, reordered or redefined gate is a different contract and fails closed.
Promotion requires 10/10 GREEN plus an independent verifier plus a human countersign together; any one of them alone promotes nothing and the countersign defaults false.
The writer can never self-close: a verifier identical to the writer, or one that does not declare independence, is refused as self-verification rather than accepted.

This contract pins one Actionplan commit, one authority chain head and one read-only Kernel commit; drift in any pin, in the frozen gate hash or in the authority head fails closed rather than degrading to a warning.
A topic found after this freeze is classified only as existing-gate-evidence, post-pilot-backlog or an explicit production blocker; it can never create an eleventh promotion gate.
Freezing a promotion contract is not promoting: this artifact records that GRP-01 is not GREEN because the Kernel consumer is stale, and it promotes nothing by itself.
nonGoals: do not read this frozen contract as a promotion, as an approval to promote, or as evidence that any gate is GREEN
do not read it as opening GO-PRODUCTION, release, deploy, SDK, app-core, app or module; every downstream stage stays shut and production is not reachable from this contract
do not start runtime implementation, write runtime, platform or Kernel product code, or treat GO-KERNEL-DEVELOPMENT-ONLY as superseded
do not perform the Kernel consumer sync here; it is the next separate change package and GRP-01 stays RED until it lands
do not add, rename, reorder or redefine a gate, and do not mutate the authority chain, the application-state ledger, the GATE-01 approval intake or any sealed EPOCH-01..04 entry
do not stage, commit, push, tag, merge or otherwise mutate Git from this shard

rollback.trigger: the frozen gate hash, an authority or Kernel pin, the promotion rule, the fail-closed evaluator or the not-promoted current status drifts
rollback.action: revert this contract, its evaluator and its test as one logical shard; nothing else depends on it and no authority, ledger or sealed epoch entry was touched
